name: Soukai Buccaneers!
source:
Rian Lawrence is a 16-year-old girl whose mother passed away when she was a child and now her father has gone missing. She dreams of becoming a seafaring adventurer, having been influenced by watching church plays, hearing epic heroic tales and learning that her missing father was also an adventurer who crossed the ocean. To fulfill this desire, she leaves the town where she has comfortably lived, and ventures to the port, King’s Bridge.

Shortly after her arrival, she gets caught up in a tussle and ends up acting in unison with pirates. From then on, she grew interested in them. Two methods of being able to go to sea appear before her- one being “pirates”, and the other, the “navy”.

Will she choose to live her life as a pirate aboard their ship; joining the elusive and whimsical crew lead by its chivalrous yet self-centred ore-sama captain and the always calm, cool and collected deputy captain with a scary smile? Or will she join the ranks of the navy; answering to a young-looking naval commanding officer who’s proud of his nobility and the older, taciturn deputy commanding officer who exudes an aura of depth?

Which will the protagonist choose? What kind of adventurer will she become? Who will become the closest partner at her side?

[Translation of the official website's plot summary.]
translation:
莱恩·劳伦斯 (Rian Lawrence) 是一名16岁女孩，她的母亲在她小时候就去世了，现在她的父亲失踪了。她梦想成为一名航海冒险家，因为观看教堂戏剧、聆听史诗般的英雄故事而受到影响，并得知她失踪的父亲也是一位漂洋过海的冒险家。为了实现这个愿望，她离开了舒适居住的小镇，前往港口国王桥冒险。

抵达后不久，她就陷入了一场争斗，最终与海盗联手。从那时起，她就对它们产生了兴趣。两种出海的方式出现在她的面前，一是“海盗”，二是“海军”。

她会选择在船上过海盗生活吗？加入由侠义而又以自我为中心的矿石大人船长和总是冷静、冷静、带着可怕微笑的副船长领导的难以捉摸、异想天开的船员队伍？或者她会加入海军的行列吗？面对一位年轻而自豪的海军指挥官和一位年长、沉默寡言、散发着深邃气息的副指挥官？

主角会选择哪一个呢？她会成为什么样的冒险家呢？谁会成为她身边最亲密的伙伴？

【官网剧情概要翻译。】
